newsitem.title: PERU: Peru central bank offers 20 mln soles 28-day CDs.
newsitem.headline: Peru central bank offers 20 mln soles 28-day CDs.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru announced Thursday its first auction of Certificates of Deposit (CDs) in almost three months, saying it would accept bids for 28-day CDs BCQZ worth 20 million soles until 1430 local time (1530 EDT) (1930 GMT).
The certificates have an April 11 starting date.
Before Thursday, the bank had not announced a CD auction since January 15 because of a lack of liquidity in the financial system.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates, which will be announced after the auction, is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
